_about: The game's own UI text in this language (already shipped in the game). Reuse these terms whenever the store text names the same thing, so the store page matches what the player sees in the game. They also show how the game addresses the player (formal / informal).

terms.yours: ที่ขูด
terms.where: Tool name (carpet strip and shop). A hand scraper blade that scrapes dried crust and mud off the carpet.

terms.yours: เครื่องดูดฝุ่น
terms.where: Tool name. A vacuum cleaner for dry dust and crumbs.

terms.yours: สายยาง
terms.where: Tool name. A water hose with a spray nozzle: wets the carpet and rinses it.

terms.yours: ที่พ่นโฟม
terms.where: Tool name. Sprays cleaning foam (carpet shampoo / detergent foam).

terms.yours: แปรง
terms.where: Tool name. A rotary scrubbing brush (a floor-scrubber machine with a spinning brush head).

terms.yours: ไม้รีดน้ำ
terms.where: Tool name. A rubber squeegee that pushes water off the carpet.

terms.yours: เครื่องดูดน้ำ
terms.where: Tool name. A wet vacuum / extractor that sucks up water and foam.

terms.yours: เครื่องเป่าพรม
terms.where: Tool name. A carpet dryer / air mover blowing warm air.

terms.yours: น้ำยาถูพื้น
terms.where: Floor tool name (right strip). Sprays floor detergent on the tiles.

terms.yours: ไม้ถูพื้น
terms.where: Floor tool name (right strip). A mop for the tiles.

terms.yours: ส่งมอบ
terms.where: Big green button that appears when the carpet is clean: give the carpet back to its owner (the client) and get paid. Hotkey H.

terms.yours: อัปเกรด
terms.where: Top-right button that opens the upgrade shop (hotkey U, shown on a key chip next to it).

terms.yours: อัปเกรด
terms.where: Caption at the top of the upgrade shop.

terms.yours: ปรับแต่งอุปกรณ์
terms.where: Big title of the upgrade shop: improve your cleaning equipment.

terms.yours: พลัง
terms.where: Upgrade stat name on every tool card: how strongly and fast the tool works.

terms.yours: พื้นที่
terms.where: Upgrade stat name on every tool card: how wide an area the tool covers in one stroke.

terms.yours: พลัง ทำงานเร็วขึ้น
terms.where: Legend under the shop title explaining the POWER stat.

terms.yours: พื้นที่ ครอบคลุมมากขึ้นต่อครั้ง
terms.where: Legend explaining the AREA stat.

terms.yours: โบนัสความเร็ว
terms.where: Pay slip line: bonus for finishing fast.

terms.yours: ไร้คราบ
terms.where: Pay slip line: bonus for a 100 % clean carpet.

terms.yours: แห้งสนิท
terms.where: Pay slip line: bonus for a 100 % dry carpet.

terms.yours: คอมโบ
terms.where: Pay slip line: bonus for spotless AND bone dry together.

terms.yours: คอมโบ!
terms.where: Big stamp slammed onto the corner of the pay slip for a combo.

terms.yours: ค่าจ้างพื้นฐาน
terms.where: Pay slip line: the base payment for the job.

terms.yours: ส่งมอบพรมแล้ว

terms.yours: ตรวจสอบ

terms.yours: ไฟส่องความชื้น

terms.en: Wet pile and puddles glow blue

terms.en: Every trace of soil glows amber
